<title>Battle Royale</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#10142a;--card:#1d2347;--fg:#fff;--ac:#ffd54f;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}

:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#10142a;--card:#1d2347;--fg:#fff}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:Arial,sans-serif;user-select:none}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,12,30,.92);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:16px;overflow:auto}
h1{font-size:40px;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--ac)}
#sk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,130px);gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
.c{background:var(--card);border-radius:10px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent}
.c.eq{border-color:var(--ac)}
.sw{height:46px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:26px;line-height:46px}
button{background:var(--ac);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 40px;font-size:22px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer}
#h{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #000;display:none}
#h>div{position:absolute}
#storm{position:fixed;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 40%,rgba(130,0,255,.45));display:none;pointer-events:none}
.ov{z-index:20}#h{z-index:8}
#sk{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(100px,1fr))!important;max-width:420px;width:100%}
#h>canvas{position:absolute}
#menu{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#171b45,#3a1c71 60%,#7a2c6b)}
h1{text-shadow:0 3px 0 #b8860b,0 6px 12px #000;letter-spacing:2px}
.c{transition:transform .12s;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a3170,#1d2347)}.c:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
#play{font-size:28px;padding:14px 60px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #b8860b}#end h1{font-size:54px}

.ic2.sel{border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--rc)}.ic2 .big{font-size:34px;height:44px}.ic2 img{width:90px;height:44px;object-fit:contain}

#idrop{margin-top:12px;padding:10px;border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:8px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;opacity:.85}

.dn{position:absolute;color:#fff;font-weight:bold;font-size:20px;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #000;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation:dnu .7s ease-out forwards}.dn.cr{color:#ffd54f;font-size:28px}
@keyframes dnu{to{transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx)),-90px);opacity:0}}
.dd{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:300px;height:300px;margin:-150px;transform:rotate(var(--a));pointer-events:none;animation:ddf .75s forwards}
.dd:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:90px;height:20px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%,rgba(255,40,40,.95),transparent 70%)}
@keyframes ddf{to{opacity:0}}

<script>( function () {

	/**
 * Full-screen textured quad shader
 */
	var CopyShader = {
		uniforms: {
			'tDiffuse': {
				value: null
			},
			'opacity': {
				value: 1.0
			}
		},
		vertexShader:
  /* glsl */
  `

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;
			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}`,
		fragmentShader:
  /* glsl */
  `

		uniform float opacity;

		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vec4 texel = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );
			gl_FragColor = opacity * texel;

		}`
	};

	THREE.CopyShader = CopyShader;

} )();

( function () {

	/**
 * Luminosity
 * http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luminosity
 */

	const LuminosityHighPassShader = {
		shaderID: 'luminosityHighPass',
		uniforms: {
			'tDiffuse': {
				value: null
			},
			'luminosityThreshold': {
				value: 1.0
			},
			'smoothWidth': {
				value: 1.0
			},
			'defaultColor': {
				value: new THREE.Color( 0x000000 )
			},
			'defaultOpacity': {
				value: 0.0
			}
		},
		vertexShader:
  /* glsl */
  `

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;

			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}`,
		fragmentShader:
  /* glsl */
  `

		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;
		uniform vec3 defaultColor;
		uniform float defaultOpacity;
		uniform float luminosityThreshold;
		uniform float smoothWidth;

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vec4 texel = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );

			vec3 luma = vec3( 0.299, 0.587, 0.114 );

			float v = dot( texel.xyz, luma );

			vec4 outputColor = vec4( defaultColor.rgb, defaultOpacity );

			float alpha = smoothstep( luminosityThreshold, luminosityThreshold + smoothWidth, v );

			gl_FragColor = mix( outputColor, texel, alpha );

		}`
	};

	THREE.LuminosityHighPassShader = LuminosityHighPassShader;

} )();

( function () {

	/**
 * Gamma Correction Shader
 * http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/gamma_correction
 */
	const GammaCorrectionShader = {
		uniforms: {
			'tDiffuse': {
				value: null
			}
		},
		vertexShader:
  /* glsl */
  `

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;
			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}`,
		fragmentShader:
  /* glsl */
  `

		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vec4 tex = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );

			gl_FragColor = LinearTosRGB( tex ); // optional: LinearToGamma( tex, float( GAMMA_FACTOR ) );

		}`
	};

	THREE.GammaCorrectionShader = GammaCorrectionShader;

} )();

( function () {

	class Pass {

		constructor() {

			// if set to true, the pass is processed by the composer
			this.enabled = true; // if set to true, the pass indicates to swap read and write buffer after rendering

			this.needsSwap = true; // if set to true, the pass clears its buffer before rendering

			this.clear = false; // if set to true, the result of the pass is rendered to screen. This is set automatically by EffectComposer.

			this.renderToScreen = false;

		}

		setSize( ) {}

		render( ) {

						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[1]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[1], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture2, vUv) +
						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[2]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[2], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture3, vUv) +
						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[3]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[3], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture4, vUv) +
						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[4]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[4], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture5, vUv) );
				}`
			} );

		}

	}

	UnrealBloomPass.BlurDirectionX = new THREE.Vector2( 1.0, 0.0 );
	UnrealBloomPass.BlurDirectionY = new THREE.Vector2( 0.0, 1.0 );

	THREE.UnrealBloomPass = UnrealBloomPass;

} )();
</script>

void main(){vec3 d=normalize(v);float h=clamp(d.y*1.3+.08,0.,1.);vec3 col=mix(b,t*.82,pow(h,.65));

 if(d.y>.02){vec2 uv=d.xz/(d.y+.3)*1.7+vec2(uT*.012,uT*.006);float c=smoothstep(.45,.85,fbm(uv));float sh=fbm(uv*1.7+3.);vec3 cc=mix(vec3(.72,.78,.9),vec3(1.),sh);col=mix(col,cc,c*smoothstep(.02,.28,d.y)*.92);}
 col*=uK;if(uLin>.5)col=pow(col,vec3(2.2));gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.);}`}));sky.renderOrder=-1;sky.frustumCulled=false;scene.add(sky);
const WU={uT:{value:0},uLin:{value:0},sd:{value:SUNDIR},sky:{value:new THREE.Color(TH.sky)},deep:{value:new THREE.Color(TH.n==='Crépuscule'?0x10203a:0x0b4a78)},fogc:{value:HZ}};

vec3 wn(vec2 p,float t){vec2 g=vec2(0.);vec2 k1=vec2(.35,.27);g+=.5*k1*cos(dot(k1,p)+t*1.1);vec2 k2=vec2(.6,.6);g+=.3*k2*cos(dot(k2,p)-t*1.7);vec2 k3=vec2(1.3,-.9);g+=.15*k3*cos(dot(k3,p)+t*2.3);vec2 k4=vec2(-2.1,1.7);g+=.06*k4*cos(dot(k4,p)-t*3.1);return normalize(vec3(-g.x*.2,1.,-g.y*.2));}

function facadeT(g,n,type,pal,mortar,frame){
 if(type==='brick'){g.fillStyle=mortar;g.fillRect(0,0,n,n);const bw=32,bh=15;for(let r=0;r<n/bh+1;r++)for(let c=-1;c<n/bw+1;c++){g.fillStyle=pal[(Math.random()*pal.length)|0];g.fillRect(c*bw+(r%2?bw/2:0)+1,r*bh+1,bw-2,bh-2)}}
 else{g.fillStyle=pal[0];g.fillRect(0,0,n,n);g.strokeStyle=mortar;g.lineWidth=2;for(let i=0;i<=n;i+=n/2){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(i,0);g.lineTo(i,n);g.stroke();g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,i);g.lineTo(n,i);g.stroke()}}

function wavesLoot(){for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),r=rnd(3,9),x=P.x+Math.cos(a)*r,z=P.z+Math.sin(a)*r,k=i===0?{w:mkW(G.h.wave%3===0)}:i===1?{a:Math.random()*4|0,n:40}:{c:pick(['bnd','mini','med','pot']),n:2};spawnItem(k,x,z)}}
function spawnWave(){const H=G.h;H.queue=6+H.wave*3;H.boss=H.wave%5===0?1:0;msg('🧟 Vague '+H.wave+(H.boss?' — BOSS !':''),'#ff6060');wavesLoot()}
function mkZ(x,z,k){const sk=SK.find(q=>q.id==='sw'),m=model(sk),b={x,z,y:th(x,z),hp:k.hp,al:1,ph:'g',team:1,zom:1,sp:k.sp,dm:k.dm,w:null,cd:rnd(0,1),st:rnd(0,6),hit:0,at:0,lc:0,hl:0,bw:0,vis:60,sk:.5,tg:null,tc:0,sl:0,n:'Squelette'};
 b.g=m.g;b.parts=m.parts;b.m=m;m.parts.forEach(q=>q.userData.bot=b);m.g.scale.setScalar(k.sc);m.g.visible=true;m.g.position.set(x,b.y,z);scene.add(m.g);bots.push(b)}
function spawnZ(){const H=G.h;let k;if(H.boss&&H.queue===1)k={hp:700+H.wave*60,sp:4.2,dm:35,sc:2.3};else{const r=Math.random();k=r<.18?{hp:35+H.wave*5,sp:7.2,dm:7,sc:1}:r<.3?{hp:220+H.wave*22,sp:3,dm:22,sc:1.7}:{hp:60+H.wave*8,sp:Math.min(6.2,4.2+H.wave*.15),dm:10+H.wave,sc:1.15}}
 for(let t=0;t<20;t++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),rr=rnd(38,62),x=P.x+Math.cos(a)*rr,z=P.z+Math.sin(a)*rr;if(Math.abs(x)<HS-8&&Math.abs(z)<HS-8&&!hits(x,z,1.2)){mkZ(x,z,k);break}}H.queue--}
function hordeUpd(dt){const H=G.h;if(!H||G.over)return;let n=0;for(const b of bots)if(b.al)n++;G.alive=n+H.queue;
 if(H.state==='pause'){H.t-=dt;if(H.t<=0){H.wave++;H.state='run';spawnWave()}}
 else{if(H.queue>0){H.sp-=dt;if(H.sp<=0){H.sp=.6;spawnZ()}}else if(n===0){if(H.wave>=H.max)finish(1);else{H.state='pause';H.t=14;P.hp=Math.min(100,P.hp+30);msg('✅ Vague '+H.wave+' terminée ! +30 vie','#4cd137');for(let i=bots.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(!bots[i].al&&!dying.some(d=>d.b===bots[i]))bots.splice(i,1)}}}}
function zAI(b,dt){const m=b.m,dx=P.x-b.x,dz=P.z-b.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;b.cd-=dt;const mx=dx/d,mz=dz/d,px=b.x,pz=b.z;mv(b,mx*b.sp*dt,mz*b.sp*dt,.6);const moved=Math.hypot(b.x-px,b.z-pz);
 if(moved<b.sp*dt*.3&&d>2.2&&b.cd<=0){const q=hitS(b.x+mx*1.3,b.z+mz*1.3,.5,b.y);if(q&&q.m.userData.hp!==undefined){b.cd=.9;hurt(q.m,3);puff(_cb.set(b.x+mx*1.3,b.y+1.2,b.z+mz*1.3),0xd7b98e,4,3);if(m.ctl)m.ctl.play('1H_Melee_Attack_Chop',false,.4)}}

 b.y=th(b.x,b.z);m.g.position.set(b.x,b.y,b.z);m.g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dx,dz);const sp=Math.min(1,moved/(b.sp*dt+1e-4));

// ----- Planeur : vitesse, plané, plongeon, virages fluides -----
function glideP(dt){
 if(P.lau>0){P.lau-=dt;P.y+=P.lau*34*dt}
 if(P.gs==null){P.gs=16;P.gsk=5;P.gx=-Math.sin(yaw);P.gz=-Math.cos(yaw)}
 const dv=keys.ShiftLeft,pt=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(keys.KeyW?1:0)-(keys.KeyS?1:0)-(joy.y||0))),alt=P.y-1.7-th(P.x,P.z);
 const vT=dv?38:24+8*pt;let sT=dv?46:10+6*pt;if(alt<16)sT=Math.min(sT,3+alt*.55);
 P.gs+=(vT-P.gs)*Math.min(1,dt*(dv?1.1:1.6));P.gsk+=(sT-P.gsk)*Math.min(1,dt*2.2);
 const ha=Math.atan2(P.gx,P.gz),ta=Math.atan2(-Math.sin(yaw),-Math.cos(yaw)),da=Math.atan2(Math.sin(ta-ha),Math.cos(ta-ha)),tr=Math.max(-2.2,Math.min(2.2,da*3)),na=ha+tr*dt;
 P.gx=Math.sin(na);P.gz=Math.cos(na);if(!dv)P.gs=Math.max(12,P.gs-Math.abs(tr)*dt*1.5);
 const str=((keys.KeyD?1:0)-(keys.KeyA?1:0)+(joy.x||0))*5;
 mv(P,(P.gx*P.gs+Math.cos(yaw)*str)*dt,(P.gz*P.gs-Math.sin(yaw)*str)*dt,.4);
 P.y-=P.gsk*dt;pm.gl.visible=!dv&&alt>6;
 $('spd').style.display='block';$('spd').innerHTML='🪂 '+Math.round(alt)+' m · '+Math.round(P.gs*3.6)+' km/h'+(dv?' · PLONGEON':'')}

// ----- Bots conducteurs -----
const wrapA=a=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(a),Math.cos(a)),clp=(v,m)=>Math.max(-m,Math.min(m,v));
function parkCar(c){c.x=c.p.x;c.z=c.p.z;c.y=c.p.y-COFF;_cf.set(1,0,0).applyQuaternion(c.q);c.h=Math.atan2(-_cf.z,_cf.x);const ca=Math.abs(Math.cos(c.h)),sa=Math.abs(Math.sin(c.h));c.s.x0=c.x-(ca*2.3+sa*.95);c.s.x1=c.x+(ca*2.3+sa*.95);c.s.z0=c.z-(sa*2.3+ca*.95);c.s.z1=c.z+(sa*2.3+ca*.95);c.s.yb=c.y;c.s.yt=c.y+1.8;c.m.position.set(c.x,c.y+.9,c.z);c.m.rotation.set(0,c.h,0)}
function botEnterCar(b,c){b.veh=c;c.bd=b;c.drv=true;c.rsv=null;c.s.yb=1e9;c.s.yt=1e9+1;c.p.set(c.x,c.y+COFF,c.z);c.q.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0,c.h,0));c.v.set(0,0,0);c.w.set(0,0,0);c.flip=0;c.steer=0;c.in={acc:0,st:0,hb:false,tb:false};b.vt=0;b.stk=0;b.rv=0;b.avt=0;b.bump=0;b.bt=0;b.wp=null;b.state='CAR';b.m.g.visible=false;if(b.m.wg)b.m.wg.visible=false}

function botDrive(b,dt){const c=b.veh;if(!b.al||!c||!c.m.parent){botLeaveCar(b);return}
 dt=Math.min(dt,.04);b.vt+=dt;_cf.set(1,0,0).applyQuaternion(c.q);const h=Math.atan2(-_cf.z,_cf.x),sp=Math.hypot(c.v.x,c.v.z),fy=c.p.y-COFF;
 let tg=null,td=75;
 if(mode!=='demo'&&b.team!==0&&P.ph==='g'&&P.hp>0){const d=Math.hypot(P.x-c.x,P.z-c.z);if(d<td){td=d;tg=P}}
 for(const o of bots){if(o===b||!o.al||o.ph!=='g'||o.team===b.team||o.veh)continue;const d=Math.hypot(o.x-c.x,o.z-c.z);if(d<td){td=d;tg=o}}
 let tx,tz;
 if(tg){tx=tg.x;tz=tg.z}else{b.tc2=(b.tc2||0)-dt;if(!b.wp||b.tc2<=0||Math.hypot(b.wp.x-c.x,b.wp.z-c.z)<14){b.tc2=9;let k=0,x,z;const R_=Math.max(30,G.r*.8);do{x=clp(rnd(-R_,R_),HS-12);z=clp(rnd(-R_,R_),HS-12)}while(k++<12&&(wet(x,z,3)||hits(x,z,2)));b.wp={x,z}}tx=b.wp.x;tz=b.wp.z}
 if(Math.hypot(c.x,c.z)>G.r*.92){tx=0;tz=0}
 const dx=tx-c.x,dz=tz-c.z,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1,err=wrapA(Math.atan2(-dz,dx)-h),L1=15+sp*.8;
 const blk=(a,L)=>{const x=c.x+Math.cos(a)*L,z=c.z-Math.sin(a)*L;return hitS(x,z,2,fy)||wet(x,z,2.2)||Math.abs(x)>HS-8||Math.abs(z)>HS-8};
 let st=0,acc=1,hb=false,tb=false,best=null,bs=1e9;
 const rels=[clp(err,1.4),0,.35,-.35,.7,-.7,1.05,-1.05,1.4,-1.4];
 for(const r of rels){const a=h+r;if(blk(a,L1)||blk(a,L1*.5))continue;const sc=Math.abs(wrapA(a-(h+err)))+.15*Math.abs(r)-(r===b.prel?.3:0)+((b.prel&&r&&Math.sign(r)!==Math.sign(b.prel))?.9:0);if(sc<bs){bs=sc;best=r}}
 if(best==null){b.rv=1.2;b.rvs=Math.random()<.5?1:-1;best=0}
 b.prel=Math.abs(best)>.2?best:0;st=clp(best*2.4,1);const bF=blk(h,L1)||blk(h,L1*.5);
 let fd=L1+10;for(let d=4;d<=L1+10;d+=3)if(blk(h+best*Math.min(1,d/L1),d)){fd=d;break}
 const vmax=Math.sqrt(2*13*Math.max(0,fd-6)),vl=Math.max(7,Math.min(vmax,40));if(sp>vl+3)acc=-1;else if(sp>vl)acc=0;if(Math.abs(best)>1.2&&sp>11)acc=Math.min(acc,0);
 if(!bF&&Math.abs(err)>1.7&&Math.abs(best)>1.2&&sp>10)hb=true;
 if(!bF&&tg&&dd>28&&Math.abs(err)<.35)tb=true;

 b.bt=(b.bt||0)+dt;if(b.bt>14){b.bt=0;b.bump=0}if(b.stk>1){b.rv=1.3;b.stk=0;b.rvs=Math.random()<.5?1:-1;b.bump=(b.bump||0)+1}

 if(b.rv>0){b.rv-=dt;acc=-1;st=b.rvs;hb=false;tb=false}
 c.in={acc,st,hb,tb};
 for(let k=0;k<2;k++)carStep(c,dt/2);
 _cb.set(0,-COFF,0).applyQuaternion(c.q);c.g.quaternion.copy(c.q);c.g.position.copy(c.p).add(_cb);c.x=c.p.x;c.z=c.p.z;c.y=c.p.y-COFF;
 _cf.set(1,0,0).applyQuaternion(c.q);c.h=Math.atan2(-_cf.z,_cf.x);const vf=c.v.x*_cf.x+c.v.z*_cf.z,sp2=Math.hypot(c.v.x,c.v.z);
 for(const q of c.parts)if(q.w&&q.att){q.m.rotation.z-=vf*dt/.42;if(q.lp[0]>0)q.m.rotation.y=c.steer*.5}

 if(sp2>5){for(const o of bots)if(o!==b&&o.al&&o.ph==='g'&&!o.veh&&o.team!==b.team&&Math.hypot(o.x-c.x,o.z-c.z)<2.6&&G.t-(o.rot||0)>.6){o.rot=G.t;o.hp-=sp2*6;o.hit=2;if(o.hp<=0)killBot(o,0,b)}
  if(b.team!==0&&mode!=='demo'&&P.ph==='g'&&!P.veh&&Math.hypot(P.x-c.x,P.z-c.z)<2.4&&G.t-(c.lh||0)>.7){c.lh=G.t;dmg(sp2*3.2,b);P.vx+=c.v.x*.3;P.vz+=c.v.z*.3}}
 const hpP=Math.max(0,c.m.userData.hp/120);if(hpP<.4&&Math.random()<dt*8)puff(_cb.copy(c.p).addScaledVector(_cf,1.8).add(_cu.set(0,.3,0)),0x444444,1,1.2);
 if(c.m.userData.hp<=0){const pos=new THREE.Vector3(c.x,c.y+1,c.z);botLeaveCar(b);c.parts.forEach(q=>detachPart(c,q,2));boom(pos,1.1);rem(c.m);return}
 if(c.flip>1.6||b.vt>55||(hpP<.22&&b.vt>3)||(b.vt>8&&tg&&td<9&&sp2<6))botLeaveCar(b)}

// ----- Événements aléatoires -----
let evT=35,evA=null,grC=2,grT=0;const mets=[],JP=[],_gd=new THREE.Vector3(),_gp=new THREE.Vector3();
const EVS=[{k:'meteor',n:'☄ PLUIE DE MÉTÉORES',d:22},{k:'grav',n:'🌕 GRAVITÉ LUNAIRE (sauts géants)',d:25},{k:'loot',n:'💰 PLUIE DE COFFRES EN OR',d:0},{k:'turbo',n:'⚡ FRÉNÉSIE : vitesse +40 %',d:22}];
function nextEv(){evT=rnd(40,55)*(S.fast===false?1.3:1)}
function evStart(){const e=pick(EVS);evA={e,t:e.d,m:0};feed(e.n);
 if(e.k==='grav')G.grav=.3;if(e.k==='turbo')G.spdM=1.4;
 if(e.k==='loot'){const r=Math.min(G.r*.8,260);for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const a=rnd(0,6.28),d=rnd(20,r),x=clp(Math.cos(a)*d,HS-12),z=clp(Math.sin(a)*d,HS-12);if(!hits(x,z,1.5))chest(x,z,undefined,1)}evA=null;nextEv();msg('💰 8 coffres en or sont apparus sur la carte !','#ffd54f')}
 else msg(e.n,'#ff9a3c')}
function evUpd(dt){if(G.over||G.t<1)return;const eb=$('evb');
 if(!evA){evT-=dt;if(evT<=0)evStart();if(!evA&&eb.style.display!=='none')eb.style.display='none';return}
 const a=evA;a.t-=dt;eb.style.display='block';eb.textContent=a.e.n+' · '+Math.ceil(Math.max(0,a.t))+' s';
 if(a.e.k==='meteor'){a.m-=dt;if(a.m<=0){a.m=.55;const near=Math.random()<.6,x=near?P.x+rnd(-45,45):rnd(-.8,.8)*G.r,z=near?P.z+rnd(-45,45):rnd(-.8,.8)*G.r;
  if(Math.abs(x)<HS-6&&Math.abs(z)<HS-6){const y=th(x,z),ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(3.5,5.2,28),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xff3b1f,transparent:true,opacity:.75,side:THREE.DoubleSide,depthWrite:false})),rock=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.4,8,6),M(0x663322,0xff4400));ring.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;ring.position.set(x,y+.15,z);rock.position.set(x,y+70,z);scene.add(ring,rock);mets.push({ring,rock,x,z,t:1.8})}}}
 if(a.t<=0){if(a.e.k==='grav')G.grav=1;if(a.e.k==='turbo')G.spdM=1;evA=null;nextEv();eb.style.display='none'}}
function metUpd(dt){for(let i=mets.length-1;i>=0;i--){const m=mets[i];m.t-=dt;m.rock.position.y=th(m.x,m.z)+Math.max(0,m.t)/1.8*70;m.ring.material.opacity=.4+.35*Math.abs(Math.sin(G.t*14));
 if(m.t<=0){G.nc=1;boom(new THREE.Vector3(m.x,th(m.x,m.z)+1,m.z),1.2);G.nc=0;scene.remove(m.ring,m.rock);mets.splice(i,1)}}}
// ----- Grappin (touche Y) -----
const grM=new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([new THREE.Vector3(),new THREE.Vector3()]),new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0x33e0ff}));grM.frustumCulled=false;grM.visible=false;scene.add(grM);
function grapple(){if(!G||G.over||P.ph!=='g'||P.veh||invOpen||P.gr||mode==='demo')return;if(grC<=0){msg('🪝 Grappin en recharge…','#ff9090');return}
 cam.getWorldDirection(_gd);let hit=null;for(let d=4;d<80;d+=1.5){_gp.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(_gd,d);if(_gp.y<th(_gp.x,_gp.z)+.25||hitS(_gp.x,_gp.z,.25,_gp.y-1)){hit=_gp.clone();break}}
 if(!hit){msg('🪝 Rien à accrocher','#ff9090');return}
 grC--;if(grT<=0||grC===1)grT=7;P.gr={x:hit.x,y:hit.y,z:hit.z,t:1.6};grM.visible=true;beep(700,.08);msg('🪝 Grappin ('+grC+'/2)','#33e0ff')}
function grUpd(dt){const g=P.gr;g.t-=dt;const dx=g.x-P.x,dy=g.y-(P.y-.6),dz=g.z-P.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz)||1,a=grM.geometry.attributes.position;a.setXYZ(0,P.x,P.y-.5,P.z);a.setXYZ(1,g.x,g.y,g.z);a.needsUpdate=true;

 const k=42*dt;mv(P,dx/d*k,dz/d*k,.4);P.y+=dy/d*k;P.vy=0;P.vx=P.vz=0;P.on=0}
// ----- Tremplins : te lancent dans les airs, planeur automatique -----

function jpUpd(dt){for(const j of JP){j.glow.scale.setScalar(1+Math.sin(G.t*6)*.08);j.cd-=dt;
 if(j.cd<=0&&P.ph==='g'&&!P.veh&&P.on&&mode!=='demo'&&Math.hypot(P.x-j.x,P.z-j.z)<2){j.cd=1.5;P.ph='a';P.gs=22;P.gsk=2;P.gx=-Math.sin(yaw);P.gz=-Math.cos(yaw);P.lau=1.4;P.y+=1;P.vy=0;msg('🚀 Tremplin !','#66f0ff');puff(_cb.set(j.x,j.m.position.y+.3,j.z),0x66f0ff,10,5);beep(500,.15)}}}
function resetFX(){G.grav=1;G.spdM=1;G.nc=0;evT=rnd(30,40);evA=null;mets.splice(0).forEach(m=>scene.remove(m.ring,m.rock));$('evb').style.display='none';grC=2;grT=0;P.gr=null;grM.visible=false;P.lau=0;feed('🪝 Y : grappin · 🚀 tremplins dans les villages')}
function botAI(b,dt){if(!b.al)return;if(b.zom)return zAI(b,dt);if(b.veh)return botDrive(b,dt);const m=b.m;

function playEmote(){if(!run||P.ph!=='g'||!P.on||P.veh)return;let e,k0=0;do{e=EMO[(P.ei=(P.ei||0)%EMO.length)];P.ei++;k0++}while(k0<EMO.length&&pm.ctl&&pm.ctl.has&&!pm.ctl.has(e[0].split('+')[0]));const sq=e[0].split('+'),du=sq.map(n=>pm.ctl?pm.ctl.dur(n):2);P.em=du.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)+.3;if(pm.ctl){pm.ctl.play(sq[0],true);let tt=du[0];for(let i=1;i<sq.length;i++){const nm=sq[i];setTimeout(()=>{if(run&&P.em>0&&pm.ctl)pm.ctl.play(nm,true)},tt*1000);tt+=du[i]}}msg('Emote : '+e[1],'#ffd54f')}
function slide(){if(P.veh)return;if(P.ph!=='g'||!P.on||P.slide>0||Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vz)<4)return;P.slide=.62;P.st=Math.max(0,P.st-12);if(pm.ctl)pm.ctl.play('Dodge_Forward',true,.62);msg('Glissade !','#9cecff');beep(150,.05)}

renderer.domElement.style.touchAction='none';
const tabs=document.querySelectorAll('.tab');tabs.forEach(t=>t.onclick=()=>{tab=t.dataset.t;tabs.forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===t));$('shopP').style.display=tab==='s'||tab==='c'?'block':'none';$('passP').style.display=tab==='p'?'block':'none';if(tab==='p')passUI();$('bot').style.display=tab==='l'?'flex':'none';$('help').style.display=tab==='l'?'block':'none';$('side').style.display=tab==='l'?'flex':'none';$('news').style.display=tab==='l'?'block':'none';shop()});
mode=S.md||'solo';document.querySelectorAll('.mc').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>{mode=c.dataset.m;S.md=mode;save();modeUI();showSkin()});$('side').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='lemo'){let em;for(let i=0;i<30;i++){em=pick(EMO);if(!pm.ctl||!pm.ctl.has||pm.ctl.has(em[0].split('+')[0]))break}if(pm.ctl)pm.ctl.play(em[0].split('+')[0],true)}else if(e.target.dataset.buy)buySkin(e.target.dataset.buy)};$('passP').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='pbuy'){if(S.vb>=950){S.vb-=950;S.pass=1;save();passUI();shop()}else e.target.textContent='Pas assez de V-Bucks'}if(e.target.id==='pall'){const T=tier();for(let t=1;t<=T;t++){if(!(S.cl||[]).includes('f'+t))claim('f',t);if(S.pass&&!(S.cl||[]).includes('p'+t))claim('p',t)}save();passUI();shop()}};gfUI();$('gf').onclick=()=>{S.fast=S.fast===false;save();gfUI();modeUI()};modeUI();$('gq').onclick=()=>setQuality((S.gq+1)%3);setQuality(S.gq==null?(TOUCH?0:2):S.gq);lobbyMode(true);showSkin();
$('inv').addEventListener('click',e=>{const d=e.target.closest('[data-d]');if(d){dropSlot(+d.dataset.d);invUI();return}if(e.target.id==='ix'){toggleInv();return}const c=e.target.closest('[data-s]');if(c){P.cur=+c.dataset.s;P.rl=0;P.use=null;invUI()}});
$('inv').addEventListener('dragstart',e=>{const c=e.target.closest('[data-s]');if(c)invDrag=+c.dataset.s});
$('inv').addEventListener('dragover',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-s],#idrop'))e.preventDefault()});
$('inv').addEventListener('drop',e=>{e.preventDefault();const a=invDrag;invDrag=-1;if(a<1)return;const c=e.target.closest('[data-s]');if(c){const b=+c.dataset.s;if(b>0&&b!==a){const q=P.inv[a];P.inv[a]=P.inv[b];P.inv[b]=q;if(P.cur===a)P.cur=b;else if(P.cur===b)P.cur=a}}else if(e.target.closest('#idrop'))dropSlot(a);invUI()});
let wheelT=0;
addEventListener('wheel',e=>{if(!run||invOpen||!G||G.over)return;e.preventDefault();const now=performance.now();if(now-wheelT<110)return;wheelT=now;if(P.bm){P.bp=(P.bp+(e.deltaY>0?1:2))%3;return}const d=e.deltaY>0?1:-1;let n=P.cur;for(let k=0;k<6;k++){n=(n+d+6)%6;if(n===0||P.inv[n])break}if(n!==P.cur){P.cur=n;P.rl=0;P.use=null;beep(380,.03)}},{passive:false});
$('mm').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!big||!G)return;const r=$('mm').getBoundingClientRect(),W=2*HS+40,x=Math.max(-HS,Math.min(HS,(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*W-HS-20)),z=Math.max(-HS,Math.min(HS,(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*W-HS-20));if(mark&&Math.hypot(mark.x-x,mark.z-z)<20)setMark(null);else setMark(x,z)});
function fr(n){requestAnimationFrame(fr);sky.position.copy(cam.position);{const tt=n/1000;sky.material.uniforms.uT.value=tt;WU.uT.value=tt;GT.value=tt;if(gradePass)gradePass.uniforms.uTime.value=tt}const dt=Math.min(.05,(n-last)/1000);last=n;if(!G)lobbyTick(n/1000,dt);if(rain.visible)rainUpd(dt);lightning(dt);if(run&&G&&!G.over)upd(dt);if(composer)composer.render(dt);else renderer.render(scene,cam)}
cam.position.set(0,60,120);cam.lookAt(0,0,0);requestAnimationFrame(fr);
</script></body></html>
